title: All-continuous intermediate-field coefficient inclusion and derived scalar extension
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, let $\Omega$ be a normed field with an algebra structure over $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and let $E$ be an intermediate field, equipped with the restricted norm topology. Put $A(P)=C(P,E)$ and $B(P)=C(P,\Omega)$ with all continuous maps [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring]. Define the ring-object map $\rho:A\to B$ by postcomposition with the inclusion $E\hookrightarrow\Omega$ [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring-map]. For every scheme $X$, define $\rho_X=p_X^*\rho:A_X\to B_X$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients, def-sfb-coefficient-map], with its induced ring-homomorphism structure, and define $T_X=L(\operatorname{Ext}_{\rho_X})=B_X\otimes^L_{A_X}-$ on the ordinary unbounded derived categories of internal modules [sk-def-sfb-module-objects, sk-def-sfb-derived-categories, sk-def-sfb-derived-extension-of-scalars]. These definitions do not require that $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be finite, that $\Omega$ be algebraically closed or complete, or that $A\to B$ be flat.
